subject: SIG questionnaire delta - re-answers, evidence, and approval path
messages:
From: Patricia Johnson <patricia.johnson@acme.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acme-corp.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SIG 2.4 - change pack and timeline

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for running through the SOC/SIG intake with us last week. Our security team just published the SIG v2.4 questionnaire with a few upstream schema changes and a set of re-answered items based on product updates. I attached the "SIG_2.4_reanswers_diff.pdf" which highlights where the questionnaire and answer set changed versus the last submission.

A couple of items to call out up-front:
- Q12 (encryption in transit): revised to ask for explicit TLS configuration for internal RPCs.
- Q78 (data retention by product): moved from descriptive to a fixed set of retention windows; your prior free-text answer will need a new canonical answer.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide the new evidence files (S3 config snippets + KMS policy lines) and whether the updated answers are acceptable? We are aiming to close SIG submissions for this quarter by end-of-week Nov 26.

If you prefer, we can accept a redline review plus a signed cover letter from your security/legal lead.

Thanks,
Patricia
Patricia Johnson
Security Program Manager, Acme Corp
patricia.johnson@acme.com

Attachment: SIG_2.4_reanswers_diff.pdf (diff view, ~120KB)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Patricia Johnson <patricia.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG 2.4 - change pack and timeline

Patricia —

Appreciate the heads-up and the diff PDF. Looping in Marissa (Security Ops) for the evidence pulls and Karthik (Legal) for any answer changes that require sign-off.

High-level plan from our side:
1) Marissa to confirm the S3/KMS snippets and produce a short evidence bundle (expected by EOD Thu 11/19).
2) I will review the diff and propose updated canonical answers for the affected questions (Q12, Q78 and any others highlighted) by Fri 11/20.
3) If Legal flags Q78 or any retention wording, Karthik will suggest language and produce a one-paragraph attestation.
4) We will return a redline + evidence bundle and a short cover note for you to accept.

Marissa — can you confirm ETA on the S3 and KMS configuration extracts? If you have a pre-packaged evidence repo we can point Patricia to, that will speed things up.

Patricia — is the document you attached the authoritative change list, or are there additional SIG sections that changed? We want to avoid missing late diff items.

Thanks,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Patricia Johnson <patricia.johnson@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 14:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG 2.4 - change pack and timeline

Rishi / Patricia —

Thanks — I've run an initial inspect against our evidence repo. Summary of findings and actions below. I'm attaching the exported diff PDF and a small evidence text file with the S3 bucket policy snippets we will provide.

What changed (short):
- Several SIG questions were reclassified from "descriptive" to "structured" (notably Q12, Q34, Q78). We have prior artifacts for Q12 (TLS cert rotation doc) but need to extract the internal RPC TLS config for Q12's new field.
- Q78 (retention): previously we supplied an operational description. SIG v2.4 now expects a selection from allowed windows (30/90/365/custom) + policy reference.

My immediate deliverables (ETA):
- evidence_s3_configuration.txt (contains bucket ARNs, example policy lines, and a pointer to the KMS key alias) — ready by Fri 11/20 09:00 PST.
- draft canonical answers for the changed fields (Q12, Q34, Q78) — will post in this thread by Fri 11/20 12:00 PST.
- a short internal note recommending Legal review for Q78 because the retention windows intersect contractual commitments to some customers.

Open question for Legal (Karthik):
- For customers where we have bespoke retention terms, do we answer Q78 with the product default (365) and note exceptions in an attached FAQ, or do we need a per-customer appendix? Karthik, if you can advise, that will let us close the canonical answer quickly.

Patricia — the PDF you sent looked authoritative. If there are any late editorial changes to the SIG template after Friday, please flag them. We want to avoid rework.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Security Operations Manager — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Attachment: evidence_s3_configuration.txt (snippet, ~4KB); SIG_2.4_reanswers_diff.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Patricia Johnson <patricia.johnson@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 16:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG 2.4 - change pack and timeline

Team —

Thanks for the clear summary. Quick legal guidance based on the review:

- Q12 (TLS/in-transit): we can provide the internal RPC TLS config snippets as evidence. No legal sign-off required — operational evidence only.
- Q78 (retention windows): because the SIG now forces a structured selection, we should answer with the product default (365 days) and include an explicit footnote referencing customer-specific retention exceptions. For customers with contractual retention differentials, we should include an appendix and flag those to the customer via separate disclosure.

Action items:
1) Marissa, produce the final evidence bundle and the proposed canonical answers; include the appendix template for per-customer exceptions.
2) Rishi, once Marissa posts the bundle, please sign off on the commercial-safe canonical answers and approve sharing externally.
3) I'll prepare a one-paragraph legal attestation for Q78 language and attach it to the submission (I have created redlines_q78.docx and attached here).

Jonas — tagging you for executive visibility; if you prefer a different default retention selection, let us know by EOD Mon 11/23. Otherwise we'll proceed with 365 + appendix approach.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Legal — Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Attachment: redlines_q78.docx
